backend.nmAutoJoin.description: Locks the automatic desktop-app pairing consent. When set, users cannot change whether this browser silently pairs with the Open Headers desktop app on the same machine.

backend.nmAutoJoinProbe.description: Locks the periodic background check for a newly installed desktop app.

backend.allowDesktopWatch.description: Locks the telemetry consent gate. When set, users cannot change whether a paired desktop app may watch this browser's network traffic, storage, and console.
